initial.name: run_code
initial.description: Execute a TypeScript program against the available tools. Takes two required arguments: `code`, the BODY of an async function (erasable syntax only; top-level `await` and `return` work), and `description`, a short summary of what the program does. Call tools as `await tools.name(args)` per the declarations in the system prompt. Only what you print or return comes back — curate it.

code.description: The program: the body of an async TypeScript function.

description.description: Clear, concise description of what this program does in active voice, 5-10 words (shown in the UI). Examples: "Count TODO markers across packages"; "Read failing test and its fixture"; "Rename config key in every cordis.yml".
